text: My son said take loan for shop, but I am worrying about hidden charges. Can you tell me what all they will cut from the amount?
en: My son said take loan for shop, but I am worrying about hidden charges. Can you tell me what all they will cut from the amount?

text: Sir, I got a message about a loan on my phone. But I don't understand—the interest rate they showing, is that the full cost or something extra also?
en: Sir, I got a message about a loan on my phone. But I don't understand—the interest rate they showing, is that the full cost or something extra also?

text: Just tell me one thing—this loan offer, the monthly payment they mention, is that including everything or after that they add some processing fee?
en: Just tell me one thing—this loan offer, the monthly payment they mention, is that including everything or after that they add some processing fee?

text: I am a farmer, no fixed salary. The loan agent called and said low interest. But how much total I have to pay back? Please explain simply.
en: I am a farmer, no fixed salary. The loan agent called and said low interest. But how much total I have to pay back? Please explain simply.

text: Didi, main security guard hoon. Loan lena hai ghar ke liye. Par ye processing fee, insurance—sab milake kitna banega? Thoda clear karo.
en: Sister, I am a security guard. Need to take a loan for the house. What about the processing fee and insurance? Can you please clarify?

text: Bhaiya, mujhe loan ka offer aaya hai phone pe. Lekin jo interest dikha rahe hain, wahi final hai ya kuch aur charges bhi hain?
en: Bro, I got a loan offer on PhonePe. But what is the final charge or are there any other charges that are visible?

text: Mere pati ka dehant ho gaya. Ab loan ka message aa raha hai. Interest rate theek lag raha hai, par koi chhupa hua charge toh nahi hai na?
en: My husband passed away. Now, here is the text of your loan payment reminder: The interest rate seems fine, but isn't there any hidden charges?

text: मैं कॉलेज पास करके नौकरी की हूँ। लोन लेना है, लेकिन मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा कि कुल मिलाकर कितना पैसा देना होगा। सारे चार्जेस बता दीजिए।
en: I have got a job after passing out from college. I want to take a loan, but I am not sure about the overall amount. Please let me know the charges.

text: नमस्ते, मेरे पास लोन का मैसेज आया है। जो ब्याज दिखा रहे हैं, वही असली कीमत है या कुछ और भी कटेगा?
en: Hello, I have received a loan message. Are they showing the interest or is it something else?

text: வணக்கம், எனக்கு போனில் கடன் ஆஃபர் வந்தது. அதில் காட்டிய வட்டி மட்டும்தானா செலவு, இல்லை வேற ஏதாவது கட்டணம் இருக்கா?
en: Hello, I received a phone call about a loan offer. Is the interest shown there the only expense, or is there any other fee?

text: If I pay the whole thing now, will there be any extra charge?
en: If I pay the whole thing now, will there be any extra charge?

text: நான் ஒரு கடை உதவியாளர். கடன் எடுக்க ஆசை, ஆனா மறைமுக கட்டணம் எதுவும் இருக்கா? மொத்தம் எவ்வளவு திரும்பி செலுத்தணும்?
en: I am a shop assistant. Are there any hidden fees, such as interest charges? What about the total refund amount?

text: என் கணவர் இறந்துவிட்டார். இப்போ கடன் ஆஃபர் வருது. வட்டி சரியா இருக்கா, இல்லை ஏமாற்று கட்டணம் ஏதும் உண்டா? தயவுசெய்து சொல்லுங்க.
en: My husband died. Right now it's a loan offer. Is the interest rate correct, or are there any hidden fees? Please tell me.

text: Can I finish my loan early? I am asking because my brother said they take fine.
en: Can I finish my loan early? I am asking because my brother said they take fine.

text: Madam, I want to clear my loan before time. Is penalty there or not?
en: Madam, I want to clear my loan before time. Is penalty there or not?

text: Suppose I give full amount next month instead of two years later — any problem?
en: Suppose I give full amount next month instead of two years later — any problem?

text: Sir, agar main pura paisa ek saath de doon to koi penalty lagegi kya?
en: Sir, is there any penalty if I pay the entire amount at once?

text: Loan jaldi band karna hai. Koi extra charge hai iska?
en: The loan is to be closed soon. Is there any extra charge for that?

text: Meri EMI time se pehle pura karna hai, kuch katega kya account se?
en: I need to clear my EMI before the due date, can I pay the dues to any of your accounts?

text: अगर मैं पूरा पैसा अभी जमा कर दूं तो कोई जुर्माना लगेगा क्या?
en: Will there be any penalty if I deposit the entire amount now?

text: நான் கடனை முழுசா இப்போவே கட்டிடுவேன், அதுக்கு ஏதாவது கூடுதல் கட்டணம் இருக்குமா?
en: Would there be any additional charges if I pay the loan in full now?

text: मेरा लोन समय से पहले बंद करना है, कोई अतिरिक्त पैसा देना पड़ेगा?
en: I want to close my loan before the tenure, can I do it without extra payment?

text: I signed the loan yesterday only, but now I am thinking... can I cancel it? How many days I have?
en: I signed the loan yesterday only, but now I am thinking... can I cancel it? How many days I have?

text: முன்னாடியே லோன் முடிச்சிடலாமா? அபராதம் ஏதும் உண்டா சொல்லுங்க.
en: Can we close the loan before that? Please tell me if there's any kind of fine or something.

text: நான் மொத்த தொகையையும் சேர்த்து கட்டினா எந்த பிரச்சனையும் இல்லையா? எதுவும் அதிகமா கேப்பாங்களா?
en: Will it be fine if I pay the entire amount at once? Will they ask for anything extra?

text: Madam, just now I took loan for shop. My wife is telling no. Within how many day I can stop?
en: Madam, just now I took loan for shop. My wife is telling no. Within how many day I can stop?

text: Hello, I am security guard. I signed some papers for loan two days back. Is there any chance to take back? How much time?
en: Hello, I am security guard. I signed some papers for loan two days back. Is there any chance to take back? How much time?

text: I am graduate, first job, I made a mistake signing loan. Can I still cancel? Please tell days limit.
en: I am graduate, first job, I made a mistake signing loan. Can I still cancel? Please tell days limit.

text: Sir, maine kal loan liya, ghar walon ko pasand nahi. Kya main cancel kar sakta hoon? Kitne din tak?
en: Sir, maine kal loan liya, ghar walon ko pasand nahi. Kya main cancel kar sakta hoon? Kitne din tak?

text: Kal hi loan sign kiya hai, abhi second thought aa raha hai. Cancel ho sakta hai kya? Kitne din ka time hai?
en: Just signed the loan agreement yesterday, and I'm already second-guessing it. Can it be canceled? How many days is it?

text: Loan liya tha, ab lag raha hai galat kiya. Cancellation ka koi option hai? Kitne din mein?
en: Had taken a loan, now it seems I did something wrong. Can we offer a cancellation policy? In how many days?

text: बेटा, मैं विधवा हूँ, कल लोन के कागजात किए। अब सोच रही हूँ रद्द हो जाए? कितने दिन में?
en: Beta, main ek vida hoon, kal hi loan ke documents kiye gaye. Now I'm wondering if it's going to be cancelled. In how many days?

text: मैंने कल ही लोन साइन किया है, अब मन बदल रहा है। क्या रद्द कर सकते हैं? कितने दिन का समय है?
en: I just signed the loan yesterday and I'm already regretting it. What can be cancelled? How many days is it?

text: நேற்று தான் கடன் எடுத்தேன், இப்போது வேண்டாம் என்று தோன்றுகிறது. ரத்து செய்ய முடியுமா? எத்தனை நாள் உள்ளது?
en: I took a loan yesterday, and now I don't want it. Can it be cancelled? How many days is it?

text: நான் விவசாயி, கடன் எடுத்தேன். இப்போது பணம் வேண்டாம். எத்தனை நாளுக்குள் ரத்து செய்யலாம்?
en: “I am a farmer who has taken a loan. No, we don't need money now. How many days can I cancel?

text: I have some extra money this month, should I pay my loan or put in FD?
en: I have some extra money this month, should I pay my loan or put in FD?

text: கல்லூரி முடித்து வேலைக்கு சேர்ந்தேன், கடன் எடுத்தேன். இப்போது வேண்டாம். எப்படி ரத்து செய்வது? எத்தனை நாள்?
en: I finished college, joined a job, and took a loan. Not now, dear. How can I cancel it? How many days?

text: My friend saying invest in mutual fund, but I have personal loan also. What is better?
en: My friend saying invest in mutual fund, but I have personal loan also. What is better?

text: I am farmer, have crop loan. If I pay early or invest in gold, which is good for me?
en: I am farmer, have crop loan. If I pay early or invest in gold, which is good for me?

text: Sir, I am security guard, got bonus. Loan EMI or invest? Please tell.
en: Sir, I am security guard, got bonus. Loan EMI or invest? Please tell.

text: Mere paas thoda paisa bacha hai, loan jaldi chuka du ya SIP start karu?
en: I have some money saved up, should I pay off the loan early or start an SIP?

text: College ke baad first job hai, education loan hai. Extra money se loan pay karu ya share market mein dalo?
en: College is a first job, education loan. With the extra cash flow, would you like to consider using it to pay off high interest debt or invest it in the stock market?

text: Didi, main shop pe kaam karti hu. Loan hai, par invest bhi karna hai. Kya karu?
en: Sister, I work in a shop. There is a loan, but it is to be invested as well. What should I do?

text: मेरे पास कुछ पैसे बचे हैं, लोन चुका दूं या निवेश करूं?
en: I have some money left, should I pay off the loan or invest it?

text: என்னிடம் கொஞ்சம் பணம் மீதி இருக்கு, கடனை அடைக்கலாமா அல்லது முதலீடு செய்யலாமா?
en: I have some cash left, should I pay off the debt or invest it?

text: मैं विधवा हूं, पेंशन का पैसा आया है। कर्ज है, क्या करना चाहिए?
en: I am a widow, the pension money has arrived. There's a debt, what should be done?

text: Madam, I am a shop assistant, my salary is 15000. How much insurance I should take for my family? Two children also.
en: Madam, I am a shop assistant, my salary is 15000. How much insurance I should take for my family? Two children also.

text: விவசாய கடன் இருக்கு, அதை முன்கூட்டியே கட்டலாமா இல்லை தங்கத்தில் போடலாமா?
en: I have a loan for agriculture, can I prepay it or make a gold investment?

text: நான் கடை உதவியாளர், கூடுதல் பணம் கிடைத்தது. வட்டிக்கு கடன் உள்ளது, என்ன செய்வது?
en: I am a cashier, and I got extra money. Have a loan on interest, what to do?

text: My husband died last year. He had one policy. Is that enough for me and my daughter or I need more cover?
en: My husband died last year. He had one policy. Is that enough for me and my daughter or I need more cover?

text: I am farmer, I have loan from bank for tractor. If something happen to me, will insurance pay the loan? How much cover I need?
en: I am farmer, I have loan from bank for tractor. If something happen to me, will insurance pay the loan? How much cover I need?

text: Just joined job after college, salary 25000. My company giving group health insurance. Is it sufficient or I take personal policy?
en: Just joined job after college, salary 25000. My company giving group health insurance. Is it sufficient or I take personal policy?

text: Bhaiya, main security guard hoon, 12000 kamata hoon. Ghar mein wife aur do bacche hain. Kitna insurance lena chahiye?
en: Brother, I am a security guard and I earn 12000. The household consists of the wife and two children. How much insurance should I take?

text: Meri mummy ke liye health insurance chahiye. Unki age 58 hai. Kitna cover sahi rahega? Hum teen bhai hain, sab milke premium denge.
en: I want to buy health insurance for my mom. He is 58 years old. How much will the cover be? We are three brothers, we will pay the premium together.

text: Sir, meri salary 18000 hai, aur main akela kamane wala hoon. Term insurance mein kitna amount lunga to family secure rahegi?
en: Sir, my salary is 18000 rupees and I am single earning. How much term insurance amount will I need for my family to be secured?

text: मेरे पति की मृत्यु हो गई। मेरे पास दो बच्चे हैं। मुझे कितना बीमा करवाना चाहिए ताकि बच्चों की पढ़ाई पूरी हो सके?
en: My husband died. I have two children. How much insurance should I get so that my children's studies can be completed?

text: मैं किसान हूँ और मेरा बैंक से कर्ज है। अगर मुझे कुछ हो जाए तो क्या बीमा से कर्ज चुक जाएगा? कितना बीमा लेना चाहिए?
en: I am a farmer and I have a loan from the bank. Will the insurance cover the loan if something happens to me? How much insurance should I take?

text: நான் ஒரு கடை உதவியாளர். எனக்கு மாதம் 15,000 சம்பளம். எனது குடும்பத்திற்கு எவ்வளவு ஆயுள் காப்பீடு எடுக்க வேண்டும்?
en: I am a shop assistant. My salary is fixed at fifteen thousand rupees per month. How much life insurance should I take out for my family? 15000

text: என் கணவர் இறந்துவிட்டார். எனக்கு ஒரு மகள் இருக்கிறாள். அவளுக்கு நல்ல எதிர்காலம் கொடுக்க எவ்வளவு காப்பீடு தேவை?
en: My husband died. I have a daughter. How much insurance is needed to give her a good future?

text: Madam, I am paying for one policy only, but my whole family is there also, wife and two children — does it cover them or I must buy separate for each?
en: Madam, I am paying for one policy only, but my whole family is there also, wife and two children — does it cover them or I must buy separate for each?

text: They are telling top-up policy is cheap, but when I will use it? I am not understanding, means I pay less premium and get more cover? How it works please explain slowly.
en: They are telling top-up policy is cheap, but when I will use it? I am not understanding, means I pay less premium and get more cover? How it works please explain slowly.

text: நான் பாதுகாப்பு காவலர். எனக்கு மாதம் 12,000 சம்பளம். எனக்கு மற்றும் எனது குடும்பத்திற்கு எவ்வளவு மருத்துவக் காப்பீடு போதும்?
en: I'm a security guard. I get 12,000 per month. How much medical insurance is enough for me and my family?

text: What is the difference between term plan and this health one? My friend saying term gives money back after some years, is it true or false?
en: What is the difference between term plan and this health one? My friend saying term gives money back after some years, is it true or false?

text: One company agent came to my shop and told family floater is better than individual. But my mother is old, she is having sugar also. So will they include her or reject?
en: One company agent came to my shop and told family floater is better than individual. But my mother is old, she is having sugar also. So will they include her or reject?

text: Didi main ek hi baar mein poora parivaar cover karna chahta hoon, alag alag nahi. Family floater mein sab log aa jayenge na, ya bachon ka alag lena padega?
en: Sister, I want to cover the whole family in one go, not separately. Will all the family members be able to join in the family floater, or do we need to book a separate one for children?

text: Term insurance matlab sirf marne ke baad paisa milega? Mere ko toh bimaari ke liye chahiye, hospital ka kharcha. Toh main health hi lu na, sahi hai?
en: Term insurance means you will get paid only after death? I need it for the illness, hospital expenses. So I will take health, right?

text: Ye top-up plan samajh nahi aa raha. Matlab pehle se ek policy hai toh hi ye lenge? Aur agar beech mein claim kar diya toh next saal cover kam ho jayega kya?
en: I'm not sure I understand what you mean by 'top-up plan'. I mean, will we take it only if there is a policy in advance? And if you claim in between, will the next year's coverage be reduced?

text: साहब, मेरे पास बैंक का लोन है। अगर कुछ हो गया मुझे, तो लोन कौन भरेगा? ऐसा कोई बीमा है जो लोन चुका दे?
en: Sir, I have a bank loan. If something happens to me, who will pay the loan? Is there any insurance that pays off the loan?

text: मेरे पति का देहांत हो गया। अभी मेरे नाम पर कुछ पॉलिसी नहीं है। मैं बच्चों के लिए कौन सा प्लान लूँ जो सस्ता भी हो और काम आए?
en: My husband died. I don't have any policy in my name right now. Which plan should I go for if I want something that is affordable and works for my kids?

text: அண்ணா, நான் கல்லூரி முடிச்சு புதுசா வேலைக்கு சேர்ந்திருக்கேன். சம்பளம் கொஞ்சம் தான். எனக்கு எந்த இன்சூரன்ஸ் முதல்ல எடுக்கணும், தெரியலயே?
en: Hello, sir, I have just completed my college and I am newly employed. The salary is a little. I don't know which insurance to take first.

text: I took a policy last month only, now I don't want it. Can I give it back and take my money?
en: I took a policy last month only, now I don't want it. Can I give it back and take my money?

text: என் அப்பா விவசாயி, கடன் வாங்கியிருக்காரு. அவருக்கு ஏதாவது ஆனா கடன் பிரச்சனை வரும். அதுக்கு ஒரு பாலிசி இருக்கா? தெரிஞ்சு சொல்லுங்க.
en: My father is a farmer and has taken a loan. He will have some kind of debt problem. Is there a policy for that? Please let me know.

text: நான் காவலாளி வேலை பாக்கறேன். மருத்துவமனை செலவு ரொம்ப ஆகுது. ஃபேமிலி ஃபுளோட்டர் அப்படின்னா என்ன? என் பொண்டாட்டி பிள்ளைங்களுக்கும் சேர்த்து கிடைக்குமா?
en: I work as a security guard. Hospital bills are very expensive. What is a family floater? Will it be available for my wife and children as well?

text: I lost my job only, so I cannot pay. This policy is just fifteen days old. Can I surrender it back?
en: I lost my job only, so I cannot pay. This policy is just fifteen days old. Can I surrender it back?

text: Madam, my shop is small, this premium is too much for me. Please cancel and refund the amount, is it possible?
en: Madam, my shop is small, this premium is too much for me. Please cancel and refund the amount, is it possible?

text: Yesterday the agent came and made me sign something. I am not understanding what it is. If I return now, I will get full money or they will cut something?
en: Yesterday the agent came and made me sign something. I am not understanding what it is. If I return now, I will get full money or they will cut something?

text: Sir, pichle hafte hi policy li hai. Ab paisa ki zarurat pad gayi. Wapas kar sakte hain kya?
en: Sir, I just noted that you joined the policy last week. Now, I need money. Can you return it?

text: Bhaiya, agent ne bola tha ki kuch nahi hoga, bas sign kar do. Ab main cancel karna chahta hoon, kitna paisa milega?
en: The agent said there won't be any issues, just sign. Now, I'd like to proceed with the cancellation, can you please confirm the amount you'll be receiving?

text: Meri fasal kharab ho gayi, loan bhi hai. Yeh insurance nikal do, paisa refund ho jayega na?
en: My crop failed, and I also have a loan. Take out this insurance, the money will be refunded, right?

text: बेटा, इस पॉलिसी को जमा करना है। मेरी तरफ़ से रुपए काट लेते हैं, मुझे कुछ नहीं चाहिए।
en: Beta, aapko yeh policy deposit deni hogi. You can cut out the $ I need, that's all I want.

text: நான் சளுக்கம் யில்லாமல் போலீஸ் மட்டும் பண்ணிட்டேன். அதை திரும்ப கொடுத்து பணம் வாங்க முடியுமா?
en: I did the police without any complaint. Can I get it back and get the money?

text: लेकिन जल्दी बताइए, दो महीने भी नहीं हुए हैं। मुझे पैसे वापस मिल जाएंगे ना?
en: But please let me know, it hasn't even been two months. I will get my money back, won't I?

text: இன்னும் ஒரு மாசம் கூட முழுசா ஆகல. பணம் முழுசா திரும்ப கிடைக்குமா சார்?
en: It's not even a full month yet. Will I get the money back completely, sir?

text: I got the message that my claim is settled but the amount is less than the bill. Why so less? I have paid full premium only.
en: I got the message that my claim is settled but the amount is less than the bill. Why so less? I have paid full premium only.

text: என் அப்பா செத்த பிறகு அம்மா பாலிசி எடுத்தாங்க. இப்போ எங்களுக்கு வேண்டாம், நிறுத்தி பணம் திருப்பி வாங்கலாமா?
en: My mother took the policy after my father passed away. We don't need it now, can we stop and collect the money?

text: Hospital bill was 60000, but you people sent only 41000. Who will pay the remaining? I am only a shop assistant, my salary is small.
en: Hospital bill was 60000, but you people sent only 41000. Who will pay the remaining? I am only a shop assistant, my salary is small.

text: Please tell me the reason for deduction. Nobody informed me anything before. My agent told full amount will come.
en: Please tell me the reason for deduction. Nobody informed me anything before. My agent told full amount will come.

text: Sir I am asking since morning, the money credited is not matching the bill amount. Are some items not covered? Kindly explain in simple words.
en: Sir I am asking since morning, the money credited is not matching the bill amount. Are some items not covered? Kindly explain in simple words.

text: Mera claim settle ho gaya hai lekin paisa kam aaya hai. Hospital ka bill zyada tha. Kya kuch kat gaya hai? Batao na please.
en: My claim has been settled, but my withdrawal was negative. The hospital bill was too much. Is anything missing? Please tell me.

text: Bhaiya bill 80 hazar ka tha, account mein sirf 55 hazar aaya. Baaki paisa kahan gaya? Main kisan hoon, loan bhi hai upar se.
en: Brother, the bill was for 80 thousand, but I only received 55 thousand in my account. Where did the rest of the money go? I am a farmer, and on top of that, I have a loan.

text: Claim settle ka message aaya but amount dekh ke hairan hua. Itna kam kyun? Koi deduction hua hai kya? Mujhe detail chahiye.
en: Saw the claim settlement message, but were confused when the amount was given. Why so little? Is there any deduction? I need the details.

text: मेरा क्लेम सेटल हो गया पर पैसे कम आए हैं। अस्पताल का बिल ज़्यादा था। बाकी पैसा क्यों नहीं मिला?
en: My claim was settled, but the money was less. The hospital bill was too high. Why haven't I been paid?

text: என் க்ளெய்ம் செட்டில் ஆயிடுச்சு ஆனா பணம் கம்மியா வந்திருக்கு. ஹாஸ்பிடல் பில் அதிகமா இருந்துச்சு. ஏன் குறைஞ்சது?
en: My claim was settled, but I received less money. The hospital bills were huge. Why is it less?

text: मैं विधवा हूँ, मेरे पति का बीमा था। बिल पूरा नहीं मिला। कृपया बताइए क्या-क्या कटौती हुई है।
en: I am a widow, my husband had insurance. Bills were not received completely. Please let me know what all deductions have been made.

text: நான் சிக்யூரிட்டி வேலை பாக்குறேன். பில் 50000 ஆனா கிடைச்சது 32000 தான். மீதி பணம் எப்போ வரும்? காரணம் சொல்லுங்க.
en: I work in security. The bill was 50000 but I received only 32000. When will the remaining amount be credited? Can you tell me what's the reason for this?

text: Hello, my father is admitted in hospital since two days. What all papers I have to bring for insurance claim?
en: Hello, my father is admitted in hospital since two days. What all papers I have to bring for insurance claim?

text: காலேஜ் முடிச்சு புது வேலைல இருக்கேன். இன்ஷூரன்ஸ் பணம் பில்லுக்கு மீட்சி இல்லை. எந்தெந்த செலவு கழிக்கப்பட்டதுன்னு தெரியணும்.
en: I'm in college and just starting my new job. The insurance money is not refunded. I want to know what all expenses were taken into account.

text: Madam my wife delivery case happened, hospital is asking money. How I start the claim, which document required?
en: Madam my wife delivery case happened, hospital is asking money. How I start the claim, which document required?

text: I am working in shop only, no time for going office. Can I do claim by phone or online only?
en: I am working in shop only, no time for going office. Can I do claim by phone or online only?

text: My mother operation done last week. We have bill and discharge paper. Anything else needed or that is enough?
en: My mother operation done last week. We have bill and discharge paper. Anything else needed or that is enough?

text: Sir mera bhai accident hua hai, hospital mein hai. Claim ke liye kya kya kagaz chahiye, thoda batayenge?
en: Sir, my brother has an accident and is in the hospital. Could you please provide more details or clarify the documents you need for the claim?

text: Mere paas policy card hai par agent ka number nahi. Claim kaise karna hai, pehle kahan phone karna padega?
en: I do have a policy card but I don't have an agent number. How can I help you with making a claim?

text: Wife ka treatment chal raha hai, paisa arrange karna mushkil ho raha. Cashless ka jhagda kya hai, bill baad mein dena hai kya?
en: Wife is getting treatment, it's becoming difficult to arrange funds. What is the dispute about cashless, do we have to pay the bill later?

text: என் அப்பா ஆஸ்பத்திரியில் இருக்கிறார். இன்சூரன்ஸ் கிளைம் போட என்னென்ன பேப்பர் எடுத்துக்கிட்டு வரணும்?
en: My father is in the hospital. What are the documents I need to bring for the insurance claim?

text: मैं मजदूरी करता हूँ, ज़्यादा पढ़ा नहीं हूँ। क्लेम शुरू कैसे होगा, पहले किसको फोन करें?
en: I work as a laborer, I am not highly educated. How does the claim start, who do I call first?

text: मेरी माँ को भर्ती किया है, अस्पताल वाले पैसे माँग रहे हैं। बीमा का कागज़ कौन कौन सा लगेगा?
en: My mother was admitted and the hospital is asking for money. What are the documents required for the insurance?

text: I am calling about my claim. You people rejected it saying documents not proper, but I submitted everything. My shop is closed since two months, who will pay?
en: I am calling about my claim. You people rejected it saying documents not proper, but I submitted everything. My shop is closed since two months, who will pay?

text: Madam, my father expired in April. We gave all papers for insurance money. Till now no response. Every time I call different person is telling different thing. Please tell me what is happening.
en: Madam, my father expired in April. We gave all papers for insurance money. Till now no response. Every time I call different person is telling different thing. Please tell me what is happening.

text: அக்கா, என் அம்மா ஆபரேஷன் ஆச்சு. பில், டிஸ்சார்ஜ் எல்லாம் இருக்கு. இன்னும் என்ன காகிதம் வேணும் சொல்லுங்க?
en: Sister, my mother had an operation. Bill, discharge, everything is there. What other documents do you need?

text: நான் காலேஜ் முடிச்சு வேலைக்கு சேர்ந்திருக்கேன். கம்பெனி இன்சூரன்ஸ் இருக்கு, கிளைம் எப்படி தொடங்குவது, யாரை கேட்கணும்?
en: I have just finished college and I am working. The company has insurance, how to initiate the claim, and who to ask?

text: See, I am security guard, night duty. I don't have time for phone call whole day. Your agent promised claim will settle in 15 days. Now 2 months over. I want to talk to senior.
en: See, I am security guard, night duty. I don't have time for phone call whole day. Your agent promised claim will settle in 15 days. Now 2 months over. I want to talk to senior.

text: I have loan from bank for tractor. Accident happened, crop also damaged. Insurance wala is saying survey not done properly. But surveyor came na, he took photos. Why you are not giving money?
en: I have loan from bank for tractor. Accident happened, crop also damaged. Insurance wala is saying survey not done properly. But surveyor came na, he took photos. Why you are not giving money?

text: Hello, mera claim reject ho gaya. Reason likha hai 'policy terms not met'. Kya matlab hai? Agent ne bola tha sab cover hai. Ab batao kya karna hai.
en: Hello, I understand that your claim was denied. The reason given was 'policy terms not met'. Can you please explain what you mean? The agent had said everything is covered. Now tell me what to do.

text: Bhai, claim ka paisa kitna din mein aayega? Main college pass out hoon, first job join kiya, bike chori ho gayi. Insurance company ko sab diya, FIR bhi. Ab har din office se call karke pareshan kar rahe hain.
en: Bro, how long will it take to get the claim amount? I passed college, joined first job, bike was stolen. Insurance company, gave everything, even the FIR. Now they are harassing me by calling from the office every day.

text: Meri wife ka operation hua tha, claim file kiya. Ab bol rahe hain pre-existing disease hai. Arre, pehle kabhi nahi tha. Doctor ka letter bhi diya. Please escalate karo, hum garib log hain.
en: Claim filed for my wife’s operation. Now they are saying it's pre-existing disease. Oh, it never was before. Also gave the doctor's letter. Please escalate this, we are poor people.

text: मेरा बीमा क्लेम दो महीने से अटका हुआ है। हर बार नया आदमी बात करता है। मैं किसान हूँ, फसल खराब हो गई, कर्ज़ चुकाना है। जल्दी निपटान करवाइए।
en: My insurance claim is stalled for two months. Every time a new man speaks. I am a farmer, my crop has failed and I have to repay the debt. Please ensure it's settled soon.

text: मेरे पति की मृत्यु हो गई। बीमा कंपनी पैसा नहीं दे रही। कह रहे हैं कागज अधूरे हैं। मैं विधवा हूँ, पढ़ी-लिखी नहीं हूँ। कोई मदद कर दीजिए।
en: My husband died. The insurance company is not paying. They are saying the papers are incomplete. I am a widow and I am uneducated. Please help me.

text: என் கார் விபத்துக்கு உள்ளானது. இன்சூரன்ஸ் நிறுவனம் இன்னும் பணம் தரவில்லை. நான் கடையில் வேலை செய்கிறேன், தினமும் போன் பண்ணி பேச முடியாது. சீக்கிரம் முடிவு சொல்லுங்க.
en: My car met with an accident. The insurance company has not paid the amount yet. I work in a shop so I can't pick up my phone every day to chat. Please do tell me so that I know quickly.

text: விவசாய கடன் உள்ளது. பயிர் நாசமாச்சு. க்ளைம் போட்டேன், ஆனால் அதிகாரி வரலைன்னு சொல்றாங்க. நான் என்ன செய்ய? தயவுசெய்து யாராவது உதவுங்க.
en: There is agricultural loan. The crop is ruined. I have applied for the claim, but they are saying no one came. What will I do? Please someone help me.

text: Sir one message came, it is saying my loan is approved but first I have to pay five thousand processing fee. Is this real or they are cheating?
en: Sir one message came, it is saying my loan is approved but first I have to pay five thousand processing fee. Is this real or they are cheating?

text: Somebody called and told me my KYC is going to expire today, they are asking to download one app and share screen. Should I do it?
en: Somebody called and told me my KYC is going to expire today, they are asking to download one app and share screen. Should I do it?

text: I got SMS saying I won lottery of 25 lakh from some company. They want my bank account number and then say pay tax first. This is genuine or fake?
en: I got SMS saying I won lottery of 25 lakh from some company. They want my bank account number and then say pay tax first. This is genuine or fake?

text: Madam a call came, the man said he is from bank and my refund is stuck and he need my ATM PIN to release it. He was talking very fast, so I am asking you only.
en: Madam a call came, the man said he is from bank and my refund is stuck and he need my ATM PIN to release it. He was talking very fast, so I am asking you only.

text: என் அம்மா மாரடைப்புல இறந்துட்டாங்க. இன்சூரன்ஸ் பணம் கிடைக்கலை. நான் காலேஜ் படிக்கிறேன், பணம் ரொம்ப தேவை. யாரோ ஒருத்தர் ஒவ்வொன்னு சொல்றாங்க. மேலதிகாரிக்கு போன் போடுங்க.
en: My mother died of a heart attack. The insurance money is not received. I'm in college, and I need money for school. Someone is saying one thing. Call the superior.

text: Bhaiya ek call aaya, bola mera account se paisa kat gaya hai aur refund ke liye OTP batao. Main darr gaya, ye sach hai kya?
en: Brother, I got a call, they said my account has been deducted and tell me the OTP for the refund. I'm speechless, is that true?

text: Mujhe ek link aaya message mein, bol rahe hain KYC update nahi kiya to account band ho jayega. Link pe click karun ya nahi?
en: I received a message that my account will be closed if I don't update my KYC. Would you like to click on the link?

text: Sir ek aadmi phone pe bol raha hai mera loan approve ho gaya hai par pehle insurance ke paise jama karo. Sahab main farmer hoon, ye baat sahi lag rahi hai aapko?
en: Sir, a man is speaking on the phone, my loan has been approved but first deposit the insurance money. Sir, I am a farmer, does this sound correct to you?

text: मुझे एक फ़ोन आया, बोल रहे हैं मेरे नाम पर कलेक्ट रिक्वेस्ट भेजी गई है, पैसे कट जाएंगे। मैं समझ नहीं पाई, ये असली है क्या?
en: I received a phone call saying that a collect request has been sent in my name, and the money will be deducted. I can't even put my head around if this is real.

text: बेटा, संदेश आया है कि मेरी केवाईसी खत्म हो रही है और इस नंबर पर आधार भेज दो। मैं अकेली रहती हूँ, बताओ ये सही है या धोखा?
en: Beta, message aaya hai ki mera KYC samay ho raha hai aur aadhar ko is number par bhejne ka. I live alone, tell me if this is true or a lie.

text: எனக்கு ஒரு கால் வந்தது, லோன் அப்ரூவ் ஆகிடுச்சு, பீஸ் கட்டுனா போதும் அப்படின்னு சொல்றாங்க. இது நிஜமா இல்ல மோசடியா?
en: I received a call saying that my loan has been approved and the payment is ready. Is it real or fake?

text: சார், எனக்கு ஒரு மெசேஜ் வந்திருக்கு, பரிசு கிடைச்சிருக்குன்னு சொல்றாங்க, பணம் அனுப்பச் சொல்றாங்க. நான் நம்பலாமா?
en: Sir, I am saying that I have received a message and I am being asked to send money. Can I trust them?

text: ஒரு ஆள் போன் பண்ணி, என்னோட ஏடிஎம் பின் நம்பர் கேக்குறார், ரீஃபண்ட் தர்றதுக்குன்னு சொல்றார். நான் குடுக்கலாமா வேணாமா?
en: Someone called me and asked for my ATM PIN, saying it's for a refund. May I know if you are willing to give or not?

text: I am running a small shop, need some money for stock, can you give loan?
en: I am running a small shop, need some money for stock, can you give loan?

text: My need is only fifty thousand for buying goods, how much interest you will take monthly?
en: My need is only fifty thousand for buying goods, how much interest you will take monthly?

text: I am working as security guard, salary coming every month, I want small money for my shop also, is it possible?
en: I am working as security guard, salary coming every month, I want small money for my shop also, is it possible?

text: Actually I am farmer, already one loan is there from bank, but now for seeds I need little more, will you help?
en: Actually I am farmer, already one loan is there from bank, but now for seeds I need little more, will you help?

text: Bhaiya shop ke liye maal lena hai, thoda paisa chahiye, kitna milega?
en: Brother, we need to buy goods for the shop, we need some money, how much will it be?

text: Meri salary se har mahine kat sakta hai, bas stock ke liye fifty thousand chahiye
en: He can deduct from my salary every month, just need fifty thousand for the stock

text: Dekho main widow hoon, ghar chalana hai, chhota business karna hai, loan milega kya?
en: Look, I am a widow, I have to run the house, do I get a loan for a small business?

text: எனக்கு கடைக்கு சரக்கு வாங்க கொஞ்சம் பணம் வேண்டும், கடன் கிடைக்குமா?
en: I need some money to buy groceries for the shop, can I get a loan?

text: मुझे दुकान के लिए माल खरीदना है, थोड़ा कर्ज़ चाहिए।
en: I want to buy some goods for the shop, I need a little loan.

text: मेरी बेटी की पढ़ाई का खर्चा है, और दुकान भी चलानी है, क्या मदद मिल सकती है?
en: I have a daughter's education to take care of and a shop to run, what can I do?

text: Hello, I am not getting any human person, only computer talking. Please connect me to somebody who can actually listen.
en: Hello, I am not getting any human person, only computer talking. Please connect me to somebody who can actually listen.

text: நான் ஒரு கடையில் வேலை பார்க்கிறேன், மாதம் சம்பளம் வரும், சிறு தொகை கடன் வேண்டும்.
en: I work in a shop, I get a salary every month, I need a small loan.

text: விதவைக்கு உதவி கிடைக்குமா? சின்ன வியாபாரம் செய்ய பணம் தேவை.
en: Will the widow get help? Starting a small business always requires some money.

text: Every time I call it is asking options options. I want to talk directly to your staff member, kindly transfer.
en: Every time I call it is asking options options. I want to talk directly to your staff member, kindly transfer.

text: I don't want to press any number. Just put a person on the line, I have complaint about my account.
en: I don't want to press any number. Just put a person on the line, I have complaint about my account.

text: Madam, my loan matter is very urgent, this machine is not understanding anything. Give me a real agent fast.
en: Madam, my loan matter is very urgent, this machine is not understanding anything. Give me a real agent fast.

text: Bhaiya machine se baat nahi karna, koi aadmi se line pe lagao na, mera kaam bahut zaroori hai.
en: Brother, don't talk to the machine, get someone to stand in line, my work is very important.

text: Yeh option wala system mujhe samajh nahi aa raha, seedha kisi executive se baat karvaiye please.
en: I'm not sure I understand the question about this option, can you please speak to an executive for more information?

text: Sir mera ek problem hai account ka, aap log ka robot baar baar repeat kar raha hai, insaan chahiye mujhe.
en: Sir, I have a problem with the account, your robot is repeatedly repeating, I need a human.

text: मुझे मशीन से बात नहीं करनी है, कोई असली आदमी फोन पर लाइए, मेरा पैसा अटका हुआ है।
en: I don't want to talk to the machine, bring a real person on the phone, my money is stuck.

text: எனக்கு இயந்திரத்தோட பேச வேண்டாம், ஒரு ஆள் கிட்ட கொடுங்க, என் கடன் விஷயம் அவசரம்.
en: I don't want to talk to a machine, give me to a human asap, I need to pay off my debt.

text: ஆப்ஷன் ஆப்ஷன் சொல்லிட்டே இருக்கு, புரியல, நேரா யாராவது ஸ்டாஃப் கிட்ட பேசணும்.
en: Options, options, I keep saying, I don't understand, I need to talk to someone directly.

text: அம்மா, நான் ஒரு மனுஷன் கூட பேசணும், இந்த மெஷின் என்னை கேட்கவே இல்லை, உடனே இணைங்க.
en: Mom, I want to talk to a human, not this machine. Connect me to the human.

text: बार-बार यही आवाज़ आ रही है, कृपया किसी कर्मचारी से बात करा दीजिए, बहुत ज़रूरी काम है।
en: Sir, I am getting the same call again and again, please get to know the concerned employee, it's a very important matter.

text: Please remove my income detail. I am not comfortable sharing it anymore.
en: Please remove my income detail. I am not comfortable sharing it anymore.

text: I told you my salary last time, but now I don't want you to use that information, okay?
en: I told you my salary last time, but now I don't want you to use that information, okay?

text: Why you are keeping my earning details? I want to take back my permission.
en: Why you are keeping my earning details? I want to take back my permission.

text: Earlier I gave my salary information but now I am telling you, don't use it for anything.
en: Earlier I gave my salary information but now I am telling you, don't use it for anything.

text: Meri kamai ki detail hata do please, ab permission nahi dena hai.
en: Please remove the details of my earnings, I don't want to be reminded anymore.

text: Maine pehle income bataya tha, par ab mujhe nahi chahiye ki aap usko use karein.
en: I had already mentioned the income, but I don't want you to use it now.

text: Jo salary maine batayi thi, usko ab band kar do, use mat karo.
en: Stop giving the salary I mentioned, don't do that.

text: मैंने पहले अपनी आय बताई थी, अब उसका इस्तेमाल नहीं करना है।
en: I had mentioned my income earlier, so I didn't think I needed to use it again.

text: मेरी कमाई की जानकारी हटा दीजिए, अब मैं अनुमति नहीं देती।
en: Please remove my earnings info, I won't permit it anymore.

text: நான் முன்பு சொன்ன வருமான விவரத்தை இனி பயன்படுத்த வேண்டாம்.
en: You don't need to use the same income data that was used before.

text: Ok madam, I am keeping the phone now, thank you very much for the help.
en: Ok madam, I am keeping the phone now, thank you very much for the help.

text: என் சம்பள தகவலை நீக்கிவிடுங்க, அதற்கு அனுமதி இப்போது இல்லை.
en: I'm afraid that removing my salary information is not permitted.

text: முன்பு கொடுத்த வருமான விவரம் வேண்டாம், அதைத் திருப்பிக் கொடுத்திடுங்க.
en: You don't need the previous income details, just the latest one.

text: Achha, that's all only. Thank you, bye bye.
en: Achha, that's all only. Thank you, bye bye.

text: Thank you sir, my problem is solved, I will go now.
en: Thank you sir, my problem is solved, I will go now.

text: Ok didi, I cut the phone now. Namaste.
en: Ok didi, I cut the phone now. Namaste.

text: Bas itna hi tha, thank you madam, namaste.
en: That's all, thank you madam, Namaste.

text: Theek hai bhaiya, main phone rakhta hoon, dhanyavaad.
en: Okay brother, I'll hang up the phone, thank you.

text: Chalo ab kaat ta hoon, aapka bahut bahut aabhar.
en: Alright, I'll cut it off now. Thank you very much.

text: अच्छा ठीक है, अब फ़ोन रखती हूँ। बहुत धन्यवाद।
en: Okay, bye for now. Thank you very much.

text: சரி, நான் போனை வைக்கிறேன், ரொம்ப நன்றி.
en: Okay, I will end the call, thank you very much.

text: जी, मेरा काम हो गया, नमस्ते।
en: Yes, I am done, hello.

text: ஆமாம், அவ்வளவுதான். நன்றி சொல்லிட்டு போறேன்.
en: Yes, that's all. Thank you and I'll go.

text: சரிங்க, என் பிரச்சனை தீர்ந்தது, வணக்கம்.
en: You're welcome, sir. I am glad that my issue is addressed.

text: What is today's weather in Chennai? Will it rain?
en: What is today's weather in Chennai? Will it rain?

text: My phone recharge got over, can you do 199 plan?
en: My phone recharge got over, can you do 199 plan?

text: Tell me the cricket score, India match.
en: Tell me the cricket score, India match.

text: Which share is good to buy now? Someone told me Tata Motors.
en: Which share is good to buy now? Someone told me Tata Motors.

text: Bhai, train ka ticket karna hai Delhi jaane ke liye, kal subah.
en: Brother, I need to book a train ticket to go to Delhi tomorrow morning.

text: Mera account balance kitna hai? SMS nahi aaya.
en: What is the current balance of my account? No SMS was received.

text: Aaj mausam kaisa hai? Bahut garmi lag rahi hai.
en: How is the weather today? It's very hot.

text: क्रिकेट का स्कोर बताओ, कौन जीत रहा है?
en: Tell me the cricket score, who is winning?

text: நாளைக்கு வானிலை எப்படி இருக்கும்? மழை வருமா?
en: What will the weather be like tomorrow? Will it rain?

text: मेरा खाता में कितना पैसा है? बैलेंस बताइए।
en: How much money is there in my account? Bring me to balance.

text: என் அக்கவுண்ட் பேலன்ஸ் எவ்வளவு? சொல்லுங்க.
en: How much is my account balance? Tell me.

text: டிரெயின் டிக்கெட் பুক் பண்ணணும், மதுரைக்கு.
en: I need to book a train ticket to Madurai.
